title: Need help with enemy and player stats design

posts.author: Mihaa
posts.body:
Hello guys i recently bought RPG Maker MV and started making a "learning" game just to get familiar with all the fumctions and things i can do using this engine. I'm not really sure how to go about player and enemy stats and recently i had made the first battle in the game, yet the player always one shots (with the basic attack) the enemy no matter how much i increase the enemies max HP or Defense stat. Using spells (magic) doesn't one shot the enemy and so I'm left confused.
Sorry if i speled anything wrong english isn't my first language.
Great thanks to anyone who answers I'll appreciate all tips and help this wonderful community has to offer
Thanks for reading all this
(I should probably mention i have 0 skills in game making,game design, coding, arts and this is my first time trying something like this)

posts.body:
